name: Duluth (United States)
description: Light blue upper half, a dark green band and a darker blue base separated by two white wavy lines for the hills and Lake Superior, with a yellow star towards the hoist.
history: Duluth is a port city on Lake Superior and the county seat of St. Louis County, Minnesota. The design by Blane Tetreault was chosen from 195 submissions in a contest arising from the Imagine Duluth 2035 process and adopted by council resolution on 19 August 2019, replacing a flag adopted in 1979.

features.role: eight-pointed star for the North Star
